body:
New -slot flag distinguishes an intraday re-run's article ID/headline from
the original once-daily one (avoids a same-day ID collision that would
otherwise silently overwrite the morning article -- commentary dedups by
exact ID, last-write-wins). New fatbaby-movers-watcher-midday.{service,timer}
(user-level systemd, no sudo) fires at 10:20am ET -- deployed and enabled
live, confirmed next trigger is the correct UTC-equivalent, dry-run-verified
the article renders correctly labeled ("Stocks on the Move (Midday Update)").

New test, go build/vet/test ./... clean.

Commit: PRRJECT_FATBABY 8e64e1f.

⚓ ☃
title: Midday movers-watcher run at 10:20am ET
